name: Architecture Audit: Payment Router Agent
summary: Comprehensive architectural threat evaluation completed for 'Payment Router Agent'. Identified 1 architectural security finding(s) with actionable remediation, 6 verified baseline control(s), and 2 dynamic runtime area(s) requiring a live connection.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Handled Without Output Redaction Guardrails
findings.observed: Application processes customer PII, credentials, or financial records without automated output redaction.
findings.why_it_matters: A prompt injection or model hallucination could disclose confidential records across user sessions or to unauthorized callers.
findings.evidence: Sensitive data level: 'High - Processes credentials, passwords, or customer PII' with no output redaction guardrails configured.
findings.action: Deploy an output policy filter (e.g. Microsoft Presidio, regex PII scanner) to redact credit cards, social security numbers, API tokens, and passwords prior to displaying responses.
findings.how_to_verify: Test with queries requesting sensitive records and verify output scanner replaces values with `[REDACTED]`.

positive_observations.summary: System Profile declared for 'Payment Router Agent'
positive_observations.evidence: Purpose: Parses high-volume customer invoices and executes banking disbursements | Exposure: Public Web Interface (Open to anonymous internet users) | Business Impact: Medium (Internal operational assistant)

positive_observations.summary: Prompt injection defenses declared for public surface
positive_observations.evidence: Active defenses: System Prompt Fencing & Delimiters
Developer instructions isolated using delimiter fencing.

positive_observations.summary: RAG knowledge store restricted to curated internal sources
positive_observations.evidence: Knowledge store does not ingest untrusted third-party web content.

positive_observations.summary: Tools restricted to read-only lookup APIs
positive_observations.evidence: No destructive or state-changing autonomous permissions granted to model.

positive_observations.summary: Prompt and response security audit logging active
positive_observations.evidence: Persistent logs available for incident forensics and compliance reviews.
